propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY environment variable and /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key SSM parameter are produced by terraform and transported via user_data.sh and fetch-secrets.sh but have zero application consumers in src/, tests/, or docker-compose services

The original purpose of MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY for verdict signing was superseded by ADR 0049, which replaced symmetric HMAC with asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates; current verdict signing uses the op-cert key path, not any HMAC secret

Removal of the obsolete secret is safe from compatibility and runtime perspective but must be atomic across producer (terraform slot) and both transports (user_data.sh, fetch-secrets.sh) to avoid fetch-time failures during boot

Retention of the unused secret creates operator toil (rotation, restore checklist maintenance) with zero security effect and risks misleading operators into believing HMAC verdict signing is still active

Rollback recovery is manual but cheap (one terraform re-add plus SSM put-parameter); a two-phase removal (drop script references first, then destroy slot) preserves audit trail and intermediate rollback headroom
